cases.title: Select available seats and movie to dynamically update price and count
cases.description: Verify that clicking available seats updates the selected count element (data-testid=selected-count) and total price element (data-testid=total-price) according to the selected movie's price from the dropdown (data-testid=movie-select).

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a seat marked as occupied does not change its selection state, seat count, or total price.

cases.title: Toggle seat selection and persist in localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking a seat like data-testid=seat-1-1 toggles its status, updates the UI and localStorage, and allows deselection by clicking again.

cases.title: Change movie selection after selecting seats
cases.description: Verify that changing the movie dropdown selection updates the total price using the new ticket price while maintaining the existing count of selected seats.

cases.title: Restore state from localStorage on page load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the page, if 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' exist in localStorage, the correct seats are marked selected and the movie dropdown reflects the stored index.

cases.title: Default state on page load with empty localStorage
cases.description: Verify that when localStorage contains no saved data, no seats are selected and the movie dropdown defaults to 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Distinguish seat statuses via legends
cases.description: Verify that the UI displays legends with data-testid=seat-select and correctly differentiates available, selected, and occupied seat states.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are clear, distinct, cover the requirements comprehensively, and are fully testable.
All cases are well-defined, actionable, and appropriately mapped to the cited requirements.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1: Normal scenario includes selecting an available seat and choosing a movie to update selected-count and total-price. Edge and boundary scenarios include clicking multiple available seats, deselecting a seat, and changing movies dynamically. Abnormal scenario involves attempting to click an occupied seat. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2: Normal scenario covers selecting specific movies ('The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', 'No Country for Old Men ($9)') and clicking seat-1-1 to store indices in localStorage. Edge scenario includes toggling seat selection off. Abnormal scenario includes interacting with occupied seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3: Normal scenario involves loading page with 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' in localStorage. Edge scenario involves loading page when localStorage is empty, defaulting to 'The Big Lebowski ($10)' with no selected seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4: Normal scenario includes calculating total price as product of selected seats count and ticket price. Edge scenario involves changing the movie selection after seats have already been selected. Abnormal scenario involves clicking occupied seats to ensure no selection change occurs. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5: Normal scenario includes viewing seat statuses via legends and distinguishing between available, selected, and occupied seats.
